newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds see $16.59 bln June inflow-ICI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds see $16.59 bln June inflow-ICI.

text.p: Net flows to stock mutual funds were $16.59 billion in June, compared to inflows of $20.54 billion in May, a mutual fund trade group said Wednesday.
The Investment Company Institutes's June stock fund figure was below the $18 billion it had estimated for the month in a report issued July 10.
For the first six months of the year, flows into stock funds have totalled $110.18 billion, compared with $138.11 billion for the corresponding period in 1996, ICI said.
Bond and income funds in June saw net inflows of $2.11 billion, dows slightly from inflows of $2.75 billion in May.
So far this year, bond and income funds have seen inflows of $9.47 billion, up from $8.52 billion in the same period a year ago.
ICI said money market funds had a net inflow of $1.21 billion in June, compared with $10.24 billion inflows in May.
In additional details, it said inflows to stock funds averaged $18.37 billion a month in the first half of 1997, against $23.02 billion during the same period in 1996.
